content: tokenizers 0.23.1: Tokenizer::from_file(path) loads tokenizer.json. encode(text, add_special_tokens) returns Encoding. Encoding has get_ids() -> &[u32], get_attention_mask() -> &[u32], get_type_ids() -> &[u32]. Pipeline: Normalizer -> PreTokenizer -> Model -> PostProcessor. get_vocab_size(with_added). with_padding/with_truncation for config.
